changes.title: Keep UIMSD freshness work off the render thread
changes.text: Opening UIMSD now keeps the recorder flush and complete warm-cache freshness validation on its loader. Only the short prepared-cache claim receives temporary scheduling priority; any cold history rebuild returns to normal priority. The raw-history checks, saved layouts, prepared Home, exact 250ms acceptance limit and visible statistics are unchanged.

changes.title: Retain failed TEST331 evidence and compare its exact successor
changes.text: Preserve the compiled Gathering-icon candidate and every failed Android, UIMSD and API36 attempt without claiming delivery. TEST332 compares the immediate TEST331 APK history and must pass full paired core, Android, display, identity and checksum gates before any private publication. Emulator evidence remains separate from physical-phone acceptance.
